meta_description: Having a resilient supply chain is essential to staying competitive. Xometry gives customers an edge when it comes to safeguarding their supply chain against disruption.
monitored_text: Resources / Supply Chain / How to Handle Supply Chain Disruption How to Handle Supply Chain Disruption Written by Tricia Contreras 2 min read Published April 30, 2025 Updated August 26, 2026 Having a resilient supply chain is essential to staying competitive. Xometry gives customers an edge when it comes to safeguarding their supply chain against disruption. Having a resilient supply chain is essential to staying competitive. A trusted network of suppliers empowers your business to be flexible and adapt to unforeseen circumstances in a way that no single supplier can. With more than 5,000 global manufacturing partners, Xometry helps customers adapt to supply chain changes like reshoring, scaling, or tariffs, so they can stay agile, minimize risk, and maintain an advantage over competitors. Here’s how Xometry gives you an edge when it comes to safeguarding your supply chain against disruption. Price Transparency: Get the Best Price, Globally & Domestically The Xometry Instant Quoting Engine® makes it easy to upload a CAD file and compare prices and lead times in just a few clicks. With more than 5,000 manufacturing suppliers in all 50 U.S. states and more than 20 countries, Xometry’s extensive network gives you options to dial in the shipping timeline and price that fit your business and budget. Xometry offers a 30-day price guarantee, giving you peace of mind that you’re getting the best price. Get an Instant Quote Sourcing Flexibility: Adapt to Changing Trade Policies Tapping into Xometry’s network of manufacturing partners means you’re not limited by the capacity or capabilities of local suppliers. Having an array of sourcing options means you can adjust to changing trade policies without compromising quality. Uncompromising Compliance: Vetted Suppliers, Guaranteed Quality Some of the biggest names in the automotive, aerospace, and defense industries trust Xometry to deliver the parts they need. Xometry puts all its suppliers through a vetting process to guarantee quality results. Xometry and many of its suppliers are ITAR-registered, ISO 9001:2015, ISO 13485:2016, IATF 16949:2016, AS9100D, and CMMC Level 2 certified. Read more about why Xometry is well-positioned to help its customers navigate turbulent times.
